resolution: THE root cause of the recovery not sticking: the cart's __fs_read host door capped readFileAlloc at 16MB. The V20 model store reads its snapshot through that door; the recovered 92-model snapshot is 23MB (6.5MB models + 16.9MB baked paint), so the read returned null, the store saw 'no snapshot', full-replayed the 575MB event log, OOM'd, and wrote a degraded 1-model snapshot — which (being <16MB) read back fine, so every dev-host boot re-degraded it (that's why the restore kept vanishing; a running watcher-supervised host also re-materialized over the install). Raised __fs_read and __fs_readfile caps to 256MB (framework/v8_bindings_fs.zig; siblings already used 64MB), committed d55cd5ef1. Proven correct: a 92-model snapshot under the read limit loads 92 on boot via the real data layer (v8cli probe) — the seam/load logic was always right, only the read cap broke it. Installed the full 23MB clean snapshot (92 models WITH paint, globalSeq=22074, events=21300, seam matches live db) while the host was stopped. Framework compiles (SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ship). Final step is the user launching 'rjit dev hmsc-int' — it will rebuild the host (fingerprint changed) and boot to the full library. All 96 models also preserved as files in recovered-models/ and a full store backup in _MODEL_RECOVERY_BACKUP_20260629/.
